text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"—W-Well then,
I'll be in your care today!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I look forward to an all-out contest.
Let's make it a good one.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
choice_data_list: That's the girl running with us today, huh.
That's the girl running with us today, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Starting this year,
she's challenging the Classic tier."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She's been doing remarkably well, you know.
She even went out of her way to come say hello.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Takes me back.
I used to greet the seniors like that too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Back then, I used to test my mettle against my seniors to make further leaps forward, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today, I must lead by example
for the juniors chasing after me.
choice_data_list: Are you sure it's okay to be that relaxed?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh, worried the rug will be pulled out from under you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun.
Do you really think I would let my guard down against a junior?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, teaching them defeat is the duty of the strong.
I merely fulfill my obligation."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then—time to go attend to my duties as the "Emperor."
